messages:
maria: kicking off late-shift regional rollout. plan: US -> EU -> APAC. staged traffic slices 20% -> 50% -> 100%. ops-lead will monitor thresholds and holdpoints.

deploy-bot: deploy started: release v2.14.3 (sha:d4f2a7e). us=20%, eu=0%, apac=0%. warm pools verified: us-west 12/12. run logs: deploybot://runs/1766124000

sam: can we pre-create an EU fallback pin for v2.14.2? want a one-command rollback if latency tails spike.

lee: adding canary checks: p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, OOMs. proposed triggers: p99 > 220ms OR 5xx > 0.5% -> hold/rollback.

deploy-bot: us ramping to 50% after warmup. snapshot: p50=60ms, p95=110ms, p99=205ms, 5xx=0.11%. no OOMs detected.

ana: FYI earlier background batch jobs increased GPU pressure in us-west; we drained 2 nodes pre-rollout and adjusted warm pool.

ops-lead: confirmed warm-pool reserve 10% in US. monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/rollout-1766124000 (live)

maria: EU is a mandatory holdpoint. require stable p99 < 230ms for 10 continuous minutes before >20% ramp. tag me on any tail movement.

deploy-bot: eu ramp to 20%. metrics: p50=72ms, p95=135ms, p99=248ms (+18% vs baseline), 5xx=0.3%. alert: eu-p99-high -> #eng-oncall.

sam: seeing transient GC spikes on eu-gpu-03 (attaching logs). restarting agent on eu-gpu-03 now.

lee: post-restart p99 improved to ~208ms. recommendation: keep EU at 20% for +15m and re-evaluate to avoid flip-flop.

deploy-bot: eu ramp hold extended. rollback ready: pinned-version=v2.14.2 (sha:a1b2c3). manual rollback command: `deploybot rollback --region eu --version v2.14.2 --reason "p99 spike"`

ops-lead: auto-rollback rules set: if eu p99 > 260ms for 5m OR 5xx > 0.5% for 3m -> auto-rollback and page oncall. thresholds enforced in alerting config.

maria: APAC warmup scheduled at 02:00 UTC, cutover 02:15 local. i'll kick warmup 15m prior. any cluster capacity notes?

ana: APAC had a maintenance window 02:00-02:10 UTC but non-disruptive; added +8 warm nodes pre-rollout. still monitor first 10m of traffic.

deploy-bot: status: US stable 50%, EU hold 20% (improving), APAC pending. release notes: https://console.redwood/releases/2.14.3 0 key fixes: batching perf, kernel selection, kvcache eviction bugfix.

maria: thanks all. i'll update this thread during APAC warmup. if anyone sees regression tag @ops-lead and run rollback. :thumbsup:
